name: Rust Fix — Dependency & Import Errors
description: Fix missing imports, use statements, and module declaration issues in Rust projects.

tasks.description: A file called io.rs uses std::io::stdin() but is missing the use statement. Add it so the file compiles.
tasks.expected_outcome: io.rs compiles with rustc without errors
setup: echo     let mut input = String::new(); >> io.rs

tasks.description: A file called main.rs has a module declaration for 'utils' but there's no utils.rs file. Either create utils.rs with a greet function or fix the module declaration.
A Cargo project in 'web_app' references an external crate 'serde' in Cargo.toml but the import in main.rs is wrong. Fix the import so 'cargo check' succeeds.
tasks.expected_outcome: cargo check succeeds in web_app directory
